description: Parity vectors for the blind-sessions output contract (grand-plan node blind-sessions; plan §L2 first slice). The output contract is the redaction gate between the executor sandbox and the borrower: it is enforced ONCE in the sandbox (apps/fleet-executor/src/blind-run.ts enforceBlindOutputContract) and AGAIN at the relay before anything is stored for the borrower (apps/relay/src/blind-sessions.ts enforceBlindOutputContract). Two implementations of one gate MUST agree byte-for-byte or the tripwire (a relay-side violation on an executor-passed output) fires on honest traffic — so, on the model of run-page-token-parity and the hv:2 harbor-card fixture, BOTH vitest suites assert every vector here. verdictVectors additionally pin the canonical-JSON verdict hash both sides compute over an accepted output.

contractVectors.name: conforming output passes and round-trips canonically
undeclared extra field refuses the WHOLE output (exfiltration channel)
over-length string refused (bandwidth cap on the output channel)
non-object candidate refused
contractVectors.reason: output must be a JSON object

contractVectors.name: nested object smuggling refused (only flat declared scalars pass)
string field with no maxLength gets the default cap (2000)

verdictVectors.name: canonical verdict hash: key order must not matter
canonical verdict hash of the refusal marker
